title: Reply to an email
summary: Open an email, start a reply, write it in the reading pane and send it yourself.

steps.say: Click an email in the list in the middle of the window.

check.prompt: Is an email shown in the reading pane on the right?

hints: The newest email is at the top of the list.
steps.why: A reply always belongs to the email you have open.

steps.say: Press Control and R to start a reply.

checks.prompt: Is a reply box with a Send button open?

hints: The Reply button with the left arrow at the top of the email does the same.
steps.why: The reply already has the sender's address filled in.

steps.say: Type your answer above the old message.
hints: Keep it short: a greeting, your answer, your name.
steps.why: The old message stays below for context.

steps.say: Check the To line, then click Send.

check.prompt: Has the reply box closed, so the reply was sent?

hints: Discard throws the reply away instead.
steps.why: You stay in charge of sending; Lumen only writes drafts.
